assistant|recommended_relay_for_life: Recommended: American Cancer Society's Relay For Life, a 24-hour team walk/run for cancer research and awareness, events year-round
assistant|recommended_heart_walk: Recommended: American Heart Association's Heart Walk, a 5K walk/run for heart disease research, held nationwide in spring and fall
assistant|recommended_race_for_the_cure: Recommended: Susan G. Komen Race for the Cure, a 5K run/walk for breast cancer research, education, and community programs
assistant|recommended_march_for_babies: Recommended: March of Dimes March for Babies, a 3-5 mile walk for premature birth prevention and newborn health, held in spring
assistant|recommended_walk_ms: Recommended: Walk MS by the National Multiple Sclerosis Society, 5K walks for MS research and programs, in spring and fall
assistant|recommended_st_jude_walk_run: Recommended: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital's Walk/Run to End Childhood Cancer, a 5K for pediatric cancer research, events in fall and July/August
assistant|recommended_step_out_diabetes: Recommended: American Diabetes Association's Step Out: Walk to Stop Diabetes, a 5K walk for diabetes research, education, and advocacy, in fall and August
assistant|recommended_light_the_night: Recommended: Light The Night Walk by The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society, a 2-mile walk for blood cancer research and patient services, in fall
assistant|recommended_autism_speaks_walk: Recommended: Autism Speaks Walk, a 1-3 mile walk for autism research, awareness, and family services, in spring and fall
assistant|recommended_making_strides: Recommended: American Cancer Society's Making Strides Against Breast Cancer, a 5K walk/run for breast cancer research, taking place in July
assistant|recommended_team_in_training: Recommended: The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society's Team In Training, endurance events (running, walking, cycling) for blood cancer research, in July and August
assistant|recommended_run_for_the_red: Recommended: American Red Cross's Run for the Red, a 5K run/walk for disaster relief, blood donations, and emergency assistance, in July
assistant|recommended_fight_for_air_clim: Recommended: American Lung Association's Fight For Air Climb, a stair-climbing event for lung disease research, education, and advocacy, in August
assistant|recommended_kidney_walk: Recommended: National Kidney Foundation's Kidney Walk, a 5K walk for kidney disease research, patient services, and organ donation awareness, in August
assistant|recommended_purplestride: Recommended: Pancreatic Cancer Action Network's PurpleStride, a 5K walk/run for pancreatic cancer research, patient services, and advocacy, in August (also June/July)
assistant|recommended_lemon_run: Recommended: Alex's Lemonade Stand Foundation's Lemon Run, a 5K run/walk for pediatric cancer research and family support, in June and July
assistant|recommended_st_baldricks_event: Recommended: St. Baldrick's Foundation head-shaving events in June and July to raise funds for childhood cancer research (not a walk/run)
assistant|recommended_walk_run_for_hope: Recommended: CancerCare's Walk/Run for Hope, a 5K for cancer patient support services including counseling, education, and financial assistance, in June and July
assistant|recommended_breathe_deep_walk: Recommended: Lung Cancer Alliance's Breathe Deep Walk, a 5K walk for lung cancer research, patient support, and advocacy, in June and July
assistant|recommended_local_charity_even: Advised searching for local charity walks/runs in the community via Active.com, Eventbrite, Charity Navigator, online calendars, social media, and community boards
assistant|making_strides_history: Making Strides Against Breast Cancer was founded in 1988 in Boston; first event had 200 participants and raised $30,000; now over 1 million participants in 200+ US locations
assistant|making_strides_funds_use: Making Strides funds support ACS breast cancer research, patient services (transportation, lodging, emotional support), and education on risk reduction and early detection
assistant|making_strides_impact: Making Strides has raised over $875 million; ACS has contributed to a 39% decline in US breast cancer deaths since 1990
assistant|purplestride_history: PurpleStride was founded in 2008 by PanCAN; first event held in San Diego, California; now over 60 locations across the US
assistant|purplestride_event_format: PurpleStride features a timed 5K run, a 5K walk, a kids' dash, and a "Virtual PurpleStride" option, in June, July, August (some locations September/October)
assistant|purplestride_funds_use: PurpleStride funds support PanCAN research, patient support (patient central, clinical trials, financial assistance), and advocacy for increased federal research funding
assistant|purplestride_impact: PurpleStride has raised over $100 million; funded 150+ research grants; supported over 100,000 patients and families
assistant|fight_for_air_climb_history: Fight For Air Climb was founded in 2007 by the American Lung Association; first event held in Milwaukee, Wisconsin; now over 60 locations across the US
assistant|fight_for_air_climb_format: Fight For Air Climb participants climb stairs in a skyscraper or stadium, individually or as a team, open to all ages and fitness levels
assistant|fight_for_air_climb_funds_use: Fight For Air Climb funds support ALA research, public education about lung disease, and advocacy for clean air, tobacco control, and healthcare access
assistant|fight_for_air_climb_impact: Fight For Air Climb has raised over $50 million; funded 100+ research grants; educated millions about lung disease risks
